verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֗ה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל דָּנִיֵּאל֙ חֵ֣לֶם חֲזָ֔ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשֵׁ֖הּ עַֽל־ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֑הּ בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ חֶלְמָ֣א כְתַ֔ב רֵ֥אשׁ מִלִּ֖ין אֲמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ḥă·ḏāh lə·ḇê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel dā·nî·yêl ḥê·lem ḥă·zāh wə·ḥez·wê rê·šêh ‘al- miš·kə·ḇêh bê·ḏa·yin ḥel·mā ḵə·ṯaḇ rêš mil·lîn ’ă·mar
verses.literal: In the first year of the reign of Belshazzar over Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions passed through his mind as he lay on his bed . . . He wrote down the dream and this is the summary of his account . . .
verses.literalPt: NO primeiro ano de Belsazar, rei de Babilônia, teve Daniel um sonho e visões da sua cabeça quando estava na sua cama; escreveu logo o sonho, e relatou a suma das coisas.

verses.original: עָנֵ֤ה דָנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוִ֖י עִם־ לֵֽילְיָ֑א וַאֲר֗וּ אַרְבַּע֙ רוּחֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א מְגִיחָ֖ן לְיַמָּ֥א רַבָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·nêh ḏā·nî·yêl wə·’ā·mar ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ bə·ḥez·wî ‘im- lê·lə·yā wa·’ă·rū ’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥê šə·may·yā mə·ḡî·ḥān lə·yam·mā rab·bā
verses.literal: Daniel . . . declared In my vision in the night I looked and suddenly the four winds of heaven were churning up the great sea
verses.literalPt: Falou Daniel, e disse: Eu estava olhando na minha visão da noite, e eis que os quatro ventos do céu agitavam o mar grande.

verses.original: וְאַרְבַּ֤ע חֵיוָן֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן סָלְקָ֖ן מִן־ יַמָּ֑א שָׁנְיָ֖ן דָּ֥א מִן־ דָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·ba‘ ḥê·wān raḇ·rə·ḇān sā·lə·qān min- yam·mā šā·nə·yān dā min- dā
verses.literal: Then four great beasts came up out of the sea each one different from the others
verses.literalPt: E quatro animais grandes, diferentes uns dos outros, subiam do mar.

verses.original: קַדְמָיְתָ֣א כְאַרְיֵ֔ה וְגַפִּ֥ין דִּֽי־ נְשַׁ֖ר לַ֑הּ חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּי־ מְּרִ֨יטוּ גַפַּ֜יהּ וּנְטִ֣ילַת מִן־ אַרְעָ֗א וְעַל־ רַגְלַ֙יִן֙ כֶּאֱנָ֣שׁ הֳקִימַ֔ת וּלְבַ֥ב אֱנָ֖שׁ יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: qaḏ·mā·yə·ṯā ḵə·’ar·yêh wə·ḡap·pîn dî- nə·šar lah ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ ‘aḏ dî- mə·rî·ṭū ḡap·payh ū·nə·ṭî·laṯ min- ’ar·‘ā wə·‘al- raḡ·la·yin ke·’ĕ·nāš ho·qî·maṯ ū·lə·ḇaḇ ’ĕ·nāš yə·hîḇ lah
verses.literal: The first beast was like a lion and it had the wings of an eagle I watched until . . . its wings were torn off and it was lifted up from the ground and made to stand on two feet like a man and given the mind of a man
verses.literalPt: O primeiro era como leão, e tinha asas de águia; enquanto eu olhava, foram-lhe arrancadas as asas, e foi levantado da terra, e posto em pé como um homem, e foi-lhe dado um coração de homem.

verses.original: וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָה֩ אָחֳרִ֨י תִנְיָנָ֜ה דָּמְיָ֣ה לְדֹ֗ב וְלִשְׂטַר־ חַד֙ הֳקִמַ֔ת וּתְלָ֥ת עִלְעִ֛ין בְּפֻמַּ֖הּ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנַּיַּהּ וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לַ֔הּ ק֥וּמִֽי אֲכֻ֖לִי בְּשַׂ֥ר שַׂגִּֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·rū ḥê·wāh ’ā·ḥo·rî ṯin·yā·nāh dā·mə·yāh lə·ḏōḇ wə·liś·ṭar- ḥaḏ ho·qi·maṯ ū·ṯə·lāṯ ‘il·‘în bə·p̄um·mah bên šin·nay·yah wə·ḵên ’ā·mə·rîn lah qū·mî ’ă·ḵu·lî bə·śar śag·gî
verses.literal: Suddenly another beast appeared which looked like a bear It was raised up on one of its sides and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth So it was told Get up and gorge yourself on flesh . . .
verses.literalPt: Continuei olhando, e eis aqui o segundo animal, semelhante a um urso, o qual se levantou de um lado, tendo na boca três costelas entre os seus dentes; e foi-lhe dito assim: Levanta-te, devora muita carne.

verses.original: בָּאתַ֨ר דְּנָ֜ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית וַאֲר֤וּ אָֽחֳרִי֙ כִּנְמַ֔ר וְלַ֨הּ גַּפִּ֥ין אַרְבַּ֛ע דִּי־ ע֖וֹף עַל־ גַּבַּיַּהּ וְאַרְבְּעָ֤ה רֵאשִׁין֙ לְחֵ֣יוְתָ֔א וְשָׁלְטָ֖ן יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ṯar də·nāh ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ wa·’ă·rū ’ā·ḥo·rî kin·mar wə·lah gap·pîn ’ar·ba‘ dî- ‘ō·wp̄ ‘al- gab·bay·yah wə·’ar·bə·‘āh rê·šîn lə·ḥê·wə·ṯā wə·šā·lə·ṭān yə·hîḇ lah
verses.literal: Next . . . as I watched suddenly another beast appeared It was like a leopard and on its back it had four wings like those of a bird The beast also had four heads and it was given authority to rule
verses.literalPt: Depois disto, eu continuei olhando, e eis aqui outro, semelhante a um leopardo, e tinha quatro asas de ave nas suas costas; tinha também este animal quatro cabeças, e foi-lhe dado domínio.

verses.original: בָּאתַ֣ר דְּנָה֩ חָזֵ֨ה הֲוֵ֜ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֗א וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָ֣ה רְבִיעָיָה דְּחִילָה֩ וְאֵֽימְתָנִ֨י וְתַקִּיפָ֜א יַתִּ֗ירָא וְשִׁנַּ֨יִן דִּֽי־ פַרְזֶ֥ל לַהּ֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן אָֽכְלָ֣ה וּמַדֱּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א בְּרַגְלַיַּהּ רָפְסָ֑ה וְהִ֣יא מְשַׁנְּיָ֗ה מִן־ כָּל־ חֵֽיוָתָא֙ דִּ֣י קָֽדָמַ֔יהּ וְקַרְנַ֥יִן עֲשַׂ֖ר לַֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ṯar də·nāh ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ bə·ḥez·wê lê·lə·yā wa·’ă·rū ḥê·wāh rə·ḇī·ʿå̄·yå̄h də·ḥî·lāh wə·’ê·mə·ṯā·nî wə·ṯaq·qî·p̄ā yat·tî·rā wə·šin·na·yin dî- p̄ar·zel lah raḇ·rə·ḇān ’ā·ḵə·lāh ū·mad·dĕ·qāh ū·šə·’ā·rā bə·raḡ·lay·yah rā·p̄ə·sāh wə·hî mə·šan·nə·yāh min- kāl- ḥê·wā·ṯā dî qā·ḏā·mayh wə·qar·na·yin ‘ă·śar lah
verses.literal: After this as I watched in my vision in the night suddenly a fourth beast appeared and it was terrifying dreadful and extremely strong with large iron teeth . . . It devoured and crushed then it trampled . . . underfoot whatever was left It was different from all the beasts . . . before it and it had ten horns
verses.literalPt: Depois disto eu continuei olhando nas visões da noite, e eis aqui o quarto animal, terrível e espantoso, e muito forte, o qual tinha dentes grandes de ferro; ele devorava e fazia em pedaços, e pisava aos pés o que sobejava; era diferente de todos os animais que apareceram antes dele, e tinha dez chifres.

verses.original: מִשְׂתַּכַּ֨ל הֲוֵ֜ית בְּקַרְנַיָּ֗א וַ֠אֲלוּ קֶ֣רֶן אָחֳרִ֤י זְעֵירָה֙ סִלְקָ֣ת בֵּינֵיהוֹן וּתְלָ֗ת מִן־ קַרְנַיָּא֙ קַדְמָ֣יָתָ֔א אֶתְעֲקַרוּ מִן־ קֳדָמַיַּהּ וַאֲל֨וּ עַיְנִ֜ין כְּעַיְנֵ֤י אֲנָשָׁא֙ בְּקַרְנָא־ דָ֔א וּפֻ֖ם מְמַלִּ֥ל רַבְרְבָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: miś·tak·kal hă·wêṯ bə·qar·nay·yā wa·’ă·lū qe·ren ’ā·ḥo·rî zə·‘ê·rāh sil·qāṯ bē·nē·hōn ū·ṯə·lāṯ min- qar·nay·yā qaḏ·mā·yā·ṯā ʾɛṯ·ʿă·qa·rū min- qo·ḏå̄·may·yah wa·’ă·lū ‘ay·nîn kə·‘ay·nê ’ă·nā·šā bə·qar·nā- ḏā ū·p̄um mə·mal·lil raḇ·rə·ḇān
verses.literal: While I was contemplating the horns . . . suddenly another horn a little one came up among them and three of the first horns were uprooted before it . . . This horn had eyes like those of a man and a mouth that spoke words of arrogance
verses.literalPt: Estando eu a considerar os chifres, eis que, entre eles subiu outro chifre pequeno, diante do qual três dos primeiros chifres foram arrancados; e eis que neste chifre havia olhos, como os de homem, e uma boca que falava grandes coisas.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית עַ֣ד דִּ֤י כָרְסָוָן֙ רְמִ֔יו וְעַתִּ֥יק יוֹמִ֖ין יְתִ֑ב לְבוּשֵׁ֣הּ׀ כִּתְלַ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵאשֵׁהּ֙ כַּעֲמַ֣ר נְקֵ֔א כָּרְסְיֵהּ֙ שְׁבִיבִ֣ין דִּי־ נ֔וּר גַּלְגִּלּ֖וֹהִי נ֥וּר דָּלִֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ ‘aḏ dî ḵā·rə·sā·wān rə·mîw wə·‘at·tîq yō·w·mîn yə·ṯiḇ lə·ḇū·šêh kiṯ·laḡ ḥiw·wār ū·śə·‘ar rê·šêh ka·‘ă·mar nə·qê kā·rə·sə·yêh šə·ḇî·ḇîn dî- nūr gal·gil·lō·w·hî nūr dā·liq
verses.literal: As . . . I continued to watch thrones were set in place and the Ancient of Days took His seat His clothing was white as snow and the hair of His head was like pure wool His throne was flaming . . . with fire and its wheels were all ablaze . . .
verses.literalPt: Eu continuei olhando, até que foram postos uns tronos, e um ancião de dias se assentou; a sua veste era branca como a neve, e o cabelo da sua cabeça como a pura lã; e seu trono era de chamas de fogo, e as suas rodas de fogo ardente.

verses.original: נְהַ֣ר דִּי־ נ֗וּר נָגֵ֤ד וְנָפֵק֙ מִן־ קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי אֶ֤לֶף אַלְפִים יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּ֔הּ וְרִבּ֥וֹ רִבְּוָן קָֽדָמ֣וֹהִי יְקוּמ֑וּן דִּינָ֥א יְתִ֖ב וְסִפְרִ֥ין פְּתִֽיחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·har dî- nūr nā·ḡêḏ wə·nā·p̄êq min- qo·ḏā·mō·w·hî ’e·lep̄ ʾal·p̄īm yə·šam·mə·šūn·nêh wə·rib·bōw rib·bə·wå̄n qā·ḏā·mō·w·hî yə·qū·mūn dî·nā yə·ṯiḇ wə·sip̄·rîn pə·ṯî·ḥū
verses.literal: A river of fire was flowing coming out from His presence Thousands upon thousands attended Him and myriads upon myriads stood before Him The court was convened and the books were opened
verses.literalPt: Um rio de fogo manava e saía de diante dele; milhares de milhares o serviam, e milhões de milhões assistiam diante dele; assentou-se o juízo, e abriram-se os livros.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית בֵּאדַ֗יִן מִן־ קָל֙ מִלַּיָּ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י קַרְנָ֖א מְמַלֱּלָ֑ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּ֨י קְטִילַ֤ת חֵֽיוְתָא֙ וְהוּבַ֣ד גִּשְׁמַ֔הּ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לִיקֵדַ֥ת אֶשָּֽׁא׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ bê·ḏa·yin min- qāl mil·lay·yā raḇ·rə·ḇā·ṯā dî qar·nā mə·mal·lĕ·lāh ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ ‘aḏ dî qə·ṭî·laṯ ḥê·wə·ṯā wə·hū·ḇaḏ giš·mah wî·hî·ḇaṯ lî·qê·ḏaṯ ’eš·šā
verses.literal: Then I kept watching because of the arrogant words . . . the horn was speaking As . . . I continued to watch . . . the beast was slain and its body was destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire
verses.literalPt: Então estive olhando, por causa da voz das grandes palavras que o chifre proferia; estive olhando até que o animal foi morto, e o seu corpo desfeito, e entregue para ser queimado pelo fogo;

verses.original: וּשְׁאָר֙ חֵֽיוָתָ֔א הֶעְדִּ֖יו שָׁלְטָנְה֑וֹן וְאַרְכָ֧ה בְחַיִּ֛ין יְהִ֥יבַת לְה֖וֹן עַד־ זְמַ֥ן וְעִדָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ār ḥê·wā·ṯā he‘·dîw šā·lə·ṭā·nə·hō·wn wə·’ar·ḵāh ḇə·ḥay·yîn yə·hî·ḇaṯ lə·hō·wn ‘aḏ- zə·man wə·‘id·dān
verses.literal: As for the rest of the beasts their dominion was removed but they were granted . . . an extension of life for a season and a time
verses.literalPt: E, quanto aos outros animais, foi-lhes tirado o domínio; todavia foi-lhes prolongada a vida até certo espaço de tempo.

verses.original: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔א וַאֲרוּ֙ עִם־ עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א כְּבַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑ה וְעַד־ עַתִּ֤יק יֽוֹמַיָּא֙ מְטָ֔ה וּקְדָמ֖וֹהִי הַקְרְבֽוּהִי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ bə·ḥez·wê lê·lə·yā wa·’ă·rū ‘im- ‘ă·nā·nê šə·may·yā kə·ḇar ’ĕ·nāš ’ā·ṯêh hă·wāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘at·tîq yō·w·may·yā mə·ṭāh ū·qə·ḏā·mō·w·hî haq·rə·ḇū·hî
verses.literal: In my vision in the night I continued to watch and I saw One like the Son of Man coming . . . . . . with the clouds of heaven He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into His presence
verses.literalPt: Eu estava olhando nas minhas visões da noite, e eis que vinha nas nuvens do céu um como o filho do homem; e dirigiu-se ao ancião de dias, e o fizeram chegar até ele.

verses.original: וְלֵ֨הּ יְהִ֤יב שָׁלְטָן֙ וִיקָ֣ר וּמַלְכ֔וּ וְכֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַיָּ֛א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֖א לֵ֣הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שָׁלְטָנֵ֞הּ שָׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי־ לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ דִּי־ לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lêh yə·hîḇ šā·lə·ṭān wî·qār ū·mal·ḵū wə·ḵōl ‘am·may·yā ’u·may·yā wə·liš·šā·nay·yā lêh yip̄·lə·ḥūn šā·lə·ṭā·nêh šā·lə·ṭān ‘ā·lam dî- lā ye‘·dêh ū·mal·ḵū·ṯêh dî- lā ṯiṯ·ḥab·bal
verses.literal: And He was given dominion glory and kingship that the people of every nation and language should serve Him His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed
verses.literalPt: E foi-lhe dado o domínio, e a honra, e o reino, para que todos os povos, nações e línguas o servissem; o seu domínio é um domínio eterno, que não passará, e o seu reino tal, que não será destruído.

verses.original: אֶתְכְּרִיַּ֥ת רוּחִ֛י אֲנָ֥ה דָנִיֵּ֖אל בְּג֣וֹא נִדְנֶ֑ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ·kə·rî·yaṯ rū·ḥî ’ă·nāh ḏā·nî·yêl bə·ḡō·w niḏ·neh wə·ḥez·wê rê·šî yə·ḇa·hă·lun·na·nî
verses.literal: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit . . . and the visions in my mind alarmed me
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, Daniel, o meu espírito foi abatido dentro do corpo, e as visões da minha cabeça me perturbaram.

verses.original: קִרְבֵ֗ת עַל־ חַד֙ מִן־ קָ֣אֲמַיָּ֔א וְיַצִּיבָ֥א אֶבְעֵֽא־ מִנֵּ֖הּ עַֽל־ כָּל־ דְּנָ֑ה וַאֲמַר־ לִ֕י וּפְשַׁ֥ר מִלַּיָּ֖א יְהוֹדְעִנַּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: qir·ḇêṯ ‘al- ḥaḏ min- qā·’ă·may·yā wə·yaṣ·ṣî·ḇā ’eḇ·‘ê- min·nêh ‘al- kāl- də·nāh wa·’ă·mar- lî ū·p̄ə·šar mil·lay·yā yə·hō·wḏ·‘in·na·nî
verses.literal: I approached one of those who were standing there and I asked him the true meaning of all this So he told me the interpretation of these things
verses.literalPt: Cheguei-me a um dos que estavam perto, e pedi-lhe a verdade acerca de tudo isto. E ele me disse, e fez-me saber a interpretação das coisas.

verses.original: אִלֵּין֙ חֵיוָתָ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י אִנִּ֖ין אַרְבַּ֑ע אַרְבְּעָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקוּמ֥וּן מִן־ אַרְעָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’il·lên ḥê·wā·ṯā raḇ·rə·ḇā·ṯā dî ’in·nîn ’ar·ba‘ ’ar·bə·‘āh mal·ḵîn yə·qū·mūn min- ’ar·‘ā
verses.literal: These four great beasts are four kings who will arise from the earth
verses.literalPt: Estes grandes animais, que são quatro, são quatro reis, que se levantarão da terra.

verses.original: וִֽיקַבְּלוּן֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔א קַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְיַחְסְנ֤וּן מַלְכוּתָא֙ עַֽד־ עָ֣לְמָ֔א וְעַ֖ד עָלַ֥ם עָלְמַיָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wî·qab·bə·lūn mal·ḵū·ṯā qad·dî·šê ‘el·yō·w·nîn wə·yaḥ·sə·nūn mal·ḵū·ṯā ‘aḏ- ‘ā·lə·mā wə·‘aḏ ‘ā·lam ‘ā·lə·may·yā
verses.literal: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever . . . yes, forever . . . and ever
verses.literalPt: Mas os santos do Altíssimo receberão o reino, e o possuirão para todo o sempre, e de eternidade em eternidade.

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן צְבִית֙ לְיַצָּבָ֔א עַל־ חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א דִּֽי־ הֲוָ֥ת שָֽׁנְיָ֖ה מִן־ כָּלְּהוֹן דְּחִילָ֣ה יַתִּ֗ירָה שִׁנַּיַּהּ דִּֽי־ פַרְזֶל֙ וְטִפְרַ֣יהּ דִּֽי־ נְחָ֔שׁ אָֽכְלָ֣ה מַדֲּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א בְּרַגְלַ֥יהּ רָֽפְסָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin ṣə·ḇîṯ lə·yaṣ·ṣā·ḇā ‘al- ḥê·wə·ṯā rə·ḇî·‘ā·yə·ṯā dî- hă·wāṯ šā·nə·yāh min- kå̄l·lə·hōn də·ḥî·lāh yat·tî·rāh šin·nay·yah dî- p̄ar·zel wə·ṭip̄·rayh dî- nə·ḥāš ’ā·ḵə·lāh mad·dă·qāh ū·šə·’ā·rā bə·raḡ·layh rā·p̄ə·sāh
verses.literal: Then I wanted to know the true meaning of the fourth beast which was different from all the others extremely terrifying devouring and crushing with iron teeth . . . and bronze claws . . . then trampling underfoot whatever was left
verses.literalPt: Então tive desejo de conhecer a verdade a respeito do quarto animal, que era diferente de todos os outros, muito terrível, cujos dentes eram de ferro e as suas unhas de bronze; que devorava, fazia em pedaços e pisava aos pés o que sobrava;

verses.original: וְעַל־ קַרְנַיָּ֤א עֲשַׂר֙ דִּ֣י בְרֵאשַׁ֔הּ וְאָחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י סִלְקַ֔ת וּנְפַלוּ מִן־ קֳדָמַיַּהּ תְּלָ֑ת וְקַרְנָ֨א דִכֵּ֜ן וְעַיְנִ֣ין לַ֗הּ וְפֻם֙ מְמַלִּ֣ל רַבְרְבָ֔ן וְחֶזְוַ֖הּ רַ֥ב מִן־ חַבְרָתַֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- qar·nay·yā ‘ă·śar dî ḇə·rê·šah wə·’ā·ḥo·rî dî sil·qaṯ ū·nə·p̄a·lū min- qo·ḏå̄·may·yah tə·lāṯ wə·qar·nā ḏik·kên wə·‘ay·nîn lah wə·p̄um mə·mal·lil raḇ·rə·ḇān wə·ḥez·wah raḇ min- ḥaḇ·rā·ṯah
verses.literal: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and the other . . . horn that came up before which three of them fell the horn whose appearance was more imposing than the others with eyes and with a mouth that spoke words of arrogance
verses.literalPt: E também a respeito dos dez chifres que tinha na cabeça, e do outro que subiu, e diante do qual caíram três, isto é, daquele que tinha olhos, e uma boca que falava grandes coisas, e cujo parecer era mais robusto do que o dos seus companheiros.

verses.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וְקַרְנָ֣א דִכֵּ֔ן עָבְדָ֥ה קְרָ֖ב עִם־ קַדִּישִׁ֑ין וְיָכְלָ֖ה לְהֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zêh hă·wêṯ wə·qar·nā ḏik·kên ‘ā·ḇə·ḏāh qə·rāḇ ‘im- qad·dî·šîn wə·yā·ḵə·lāh lə·hō·wn
verses.literal: As I watched this horn was waging war against the saints and prevailing against them
verses.literalPt: Eu olhava, e eis que este chifre fazia guerra contra os santos, e prevaleceu contra eles.

verses.original: עַ֣ד דִּֽי־ אֲתָ֗ה עַתִּיק֙ יֽוֹמַיָּ֔א וְדִינָ֣א יְהִ֔ב לְקַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְזִמְנָ֣א מְטָ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתָ֖א הֶחֱסִ֥נוּ קַדִּישִֽׁין׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ dî- ’ă·ṯāh ‘at·tîq yō·w·may·yā wə·ḏî·nā yə·hiḇ lə·qad·dî·šê ‘el·yō·w·nîn wə·zim·nā mə·ṭāh ū·mal·ḵū·ṯā he·ḥĕ·si·nū qad·dî·šîn
verses.literal: until . . . the Ancient of Days arrived and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High and the time came for them to possess the kingdom
verses.literalPt: Até que veio o ancião de dias, e fez justiça aos santos do Altíssimo; e chegou o tempo em que os santos possuíram o reino.

verses.original: כֵּן֮ אֲמַר֒ חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א מַלְכ֤וּ רְבִיעָיָא תֶּהֱוֵ֣א בְאַרְעָ֔א דִּ֥י תִשְׁנֵ֖א מִן־ כָּל־ מַלְכְוָתָ֑א וְתֵאכֻל֙ כָּל־ אַרְעָ֔א וּתְדוּשִׁנַּ֖הּ וְתַדְּקִנַּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kên ’ă·mar ḥê·wə·ṯā rə·ḇî·‘ā·yə·ṯā mal·ḵū rə·ḇī·ʿå̄·yå̄ te·hĕ·wê ḇə·’ar·‘ā dî ṯiš·nê min- kāl- mal·ḵə·wā·ṯā wə·ṯê·ḵul kāl- ’ar·‘ā ū·ṯə·ḏū·šin·nah wə·ṯad·də·qin·nah
verses.literal: This is what he said The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on the earth . . . different from all the other kingdoms and it will devour the whole earth trample it down and crush it
verses.literalPt: Disse assim: O quarto animal será o quarto reino na terra, o qual será diferente de todos os reinos; e devorará toda a terra, e a pisará aos pés, e a fará em pedaços.

verses.original: וְקַרְנַיָּ֣א עֲשַׂ֔ר מִנַּהּ֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ה עַשְׂרָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקֻמ֑וּן וְאָחֳרָ֞ן יְק֣וּם אַחֲרֵיה֗וֹן וְה֤וּא יִשְׁנֵא֙ מִן־ קַדְמָיֵ֔א וּתְלָתָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְהַשְׁפִּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qar·nay·yā ‘ă·śar min·nah mal·ḵū·ṯāh ‘aś·rāh mal·ḵîn yə·qu·mūn wə·’ā·ḥo·rān yə·qūm ’a·ḥă·rê·hō·wn wə·hū yiš·nê min- qaḏ·mā·yê ū·ṯə·lā·ṯāh mal·ḵîn yə·haš·pil
verses.literal: And the ten horns are ten kings who will rise from this kingdom After them another king different from the earlier ones will rise and subdue three kings
verses.literalPt: E, quanto aos dez chifres, daquele mesmo reino se levantarão dez reis; e depois deles se levantará outro, o qual será diferente dos primeiros, e abaterá a três reis.

verses.original: וּמִלִּ֗ין לְצַ֤ד עִלָּיָא יְמַלִּ֔ל וּלְקַדִּישֵׁ֥י עֶלְיוֹנִ֖ין יְבַלֵּ֑א וְיִסְבַּ֗ר לְהַשְׁנָיָה֙ זִמְנִ֣ין וְדָ֔ת וְיִתְיַהֲב֣וּן בִּידֵ֔הּ עַד־ עִדָּ֥ן וְעִדָּנִ֖ין וּפְלַ֥ג עִדָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mil·lîn lə·ṣaḏ ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ yə·mal·lil ū·lə·qad·dî·šê ‘el·yō·w·nîn yə·ḇal·lê wə·yis·bar lə·haš·nā·yāh zim·nîn wə·ḏāṯ wə·yiṯ·ya·hă·ḇūn bî·ḏêh ‘aḏ- ‘id·dān wə·‘id·dā·nîn ū·p̄ə·laḡ ‘id·dān
verses.literal: He will speak out . . . against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High intending to change the appointed times and laws and the saints will be given into his hand for a time and times and half a time
verses.literalPt: E proferirá palavras contra o Altíssimo, e destruirá os santos do Altíssimo, e cuidará em mudar os tempos e a lei; e eles serão entregues na sua mão, por um tempo, e tempos, e a metade de um tempo.

verses.original: וְדִינָ֖א יִתִּ֑ב וְשָׁלְטָנֵ֣הּ יְהַעְדּ֔וֹן לְהַשְׁמָדָ֥ה וּלְהוֹבָדָ֖ה עַד־ סוֹפָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏî·nā yit·tiḇ wə·šā·lə·ṭā·nêh yə·ha‘·dō·wn lə·haš·mā·ḏāh ū·lə·hō·w·ḇā·ḏāh ‘aḏ- sō·w·p̄ā
verses.literal: But the court will convene and his dominion will be taken away and completely destroyed . . . forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas o juízo será estabelecido, e eles tirarão o seu domínio, para o destruir e para o desfazer até ao fim.

verses.original: וּמַלְכוּתָ֨ה וְשָׁלְטָנָ֜א וּרְבוּתָ֗א דִּ֚י מַלְכְוָת֙ תְּח֣וֹת כָּל־ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהִיבַ֕ת לְעַ֖ם קַדִּישֵׁ֣י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְכֹל֙ שָׁלְטָ֣נַיָּ֔א לֵ֥הּ יִפְלְח֖וּן וְיִֽשְׁתַּמְּעֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·ḵū·ṯāh wə·šā·lə·ṭā·nā ū·rə·ḇū·ṯā dî mal·ḵə·wāṯ tə·ḥō·wṯ kāl- šə·may·yā yə·hî·ḇaṯ lə·‘am qad·dî·šê ‘el·yō·w·nîn mal·ḵū·ṯêh mal·ḵūṯ ‘ā·lam wə·ḵōl šā·lə·ṭā·nay·yā lêh yip̄·lə·ḥūn wə·yiš·tam·mə·‘ūn
verses.literal: Then the sovereignty dominion and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people the saints of the Most High His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom and all rulers will serve and obey Him
verses.literalPt: E o reino, e o domínio, e a majestade dos reinos debaixo de todo o céu serão dados ao povo dos santos do Altíssimo; o seu reino será um reino eterno, e todos os domínios o servirão, e lhe obedecerão.

verses.original: עַד־ כָּ֖ה סוֹפָ֣א דִֽי־ מִלְּתָ֑א אֲנָ֨ה דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל שַׂגִּ֣יא׀ רַעְיוֹנַ֣י יְבַהֲלֻנַּ֗נִי וְזִיוַי֙ יִשְׁתַּנּ֣וֹן עֲלַ֔י וּמִלְּתָ֖א בְּלִבִּ֥י נִטְרֵֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- kāh sō·w·p̄ā ḏî- mil·lə·ṯā ’ă·nāh ḏā·nî·yêl śag·gî ra‘·yō·w·nay yə·ḇa·hă·lun·na·nî wə·zî·way yiš·tan·nō·wn ‘ă·lay ū·mil·lə·ṯā bə·lib·bî niṭ·rêṯ
verses.literal: Thus ends the matter As for me Daniel my thoughts troubled me greatly and my face turned pale . . . But I kept the matter to myself
verses.literalPt: Aqui terminou o assunto. Quanto a mim, Daniel, os meus pensamentos muito me perturbaram, e mudou-se em mim o meu semblante; mas guardei o assunto no meu coração.
